- Filter the input list to retain numbers whose decimal representation contains only odd digits: for each number n, convert to string (or iterate digits via modulo) and check all digits d satisfy int(d) % 2 == 1.
- Collect the filtered numbers into a list, remove duplicates if needed by using a set or by relying on sorting then unique, depending on requirement; specification implies using each element as-is (no dedup mentioned), so keep original multiplicity unless clarified.
- Return the filtered list sorted in increasing order using sorted().
